page_title: TOR 0-0 FRO | Torino v Frosinone 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:12.
90+3' Frosinone control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+1' Duvan Zapata (Torino) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Here comes a substitution. Walid Cheddira is given a rest as he is replaced by Marvin Cuni (Frosinone).
88' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Matias Soule is replaced by Reinier (Frosinone).
87' Adrien Tameze (Torino) is cautioned by the referee.
86' Substitution. Ivan Ilic will be replaced by Matteo Lovato (Torino).
84' Ivan Ilic (Torino) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
84' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes a direct free kick.
83' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) has tested the patience of referee Antonio Rapuano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) will replace Luca Mazzitelli.
80' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
78' Here is a change. Marco Brescianini is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Demba Seck (Frosinone).
77' The Frosinone players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
76' Mergim Vojvoda will be replaced by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
76' 2:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
74' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle as Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
71' A huge rebound finds Matias Soule (Frosinone) unmarked on the edge of the box. He lines up a shot but slips just before he hits it and sends the ball miles wide of the left post.
70' The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
69' The game is interrupted. Ivan Ilic (Torino) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
68' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Matteo Paro has decided to substitute David Okereke and he is replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Torino).
66' A player from Frosinone commits a rough challenge. Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
63' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

63' Duvan Zapata (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Karol Linetty (Torino) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Karol Linetty (Torino) was quite harsh and Antonio Rapuano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' Frosinone earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
60' 9:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
58' The ball is out of play and Frosinone manage to earn a corner.

58' Great solo effort by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
57' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Torino.
57' Stefano Turati blocks David Okereke (Torino)'s effort from the edge of the box.
56' Torino are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.

54' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Antonio Rapuano with no other option than to blow for a foul.
48' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The ball is cleared after Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
44' Duvan Zapata (Torino) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Stefano Turati and he's equal to it.
43' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Rapuano saw the whole situation.
42' Flag up against Walid Cheddira (Frosinone). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
42' Frosinone seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) was too aggressive in his challenge.
38' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic easily deals with the threat.
35' The ball is out of play. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner.
34' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
33' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
32' The linesman makes the right call and Torino will have a corner.
31' Good team movement sets up Raoul Bellanova (Torino) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
31' Total attempts – 4:4.
28' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Duvan Zapata (Torino).
25' The referee signals a corner kick to Torino.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

23' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) latches on to the corner kick on the edge of the box and releases a quick strike. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the right post.
23' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
21' The Frosinone players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and denies him.
16' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) commits a foul after dangerous play.
15' The opposition back off Matias Soule (Frosinone) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
11' A cross into the box from Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is cleared.
9' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
8' Duvan Zapata (Torino) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
7' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Antonio Rapuano blows the whistle, Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) is penalised for a foul.
5' Karol Linetty (Torino) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt.
4' The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
3' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Frosinone will take the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
